description: Cursor hook template: invoke judge-jev after tool use when JUDGE_JEV_AUTO=1. Exit 3 (escalate) is surfaced as a failure; 10/11 are operational errors and do not block. Add --mock only for smoke-testing the wiring, never as a real safety check.
command: bash -lc 'ROOT="${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; [ "${JUDGE_JEV_AUTO:-}" = 1 ] || exit 0; "$ROOT/scripts/judge-jev" run --rubric agent-trajectory --input "$JUDGE_JEV_INPUT"; code=$?; case $code in 3) exit 1 ;; 10|11) echo "judge-jev: could not judge (exit $code)" >&2; exit 0 ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac'
